daily.summary_zh: 一套装进 Claude Code 的漏洞挖掘技能包，让 AI 助手按资深安全研究员的思路协助做授权范围内的漏洞挖掘和外部红队测试。内含大量技能、快捷命令和已公开漏洞报告中的模式，覆盖多种常见漏洞类型，并附带企业身份与基础设施的攻击面清单、项目目录模板和 Burp 集成。

daily.name: erkamyaman/rust-anything
daily.description: Rewrite your whole app in Rust, one piece at a time, checked against the original's recorded behavior at every step. CLIs, HTTP servers and libraries in TypeScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby and Java.
candidate_sources: GitHub search: topic:agent-skills stars:>=30 archived:false (updated)
